description: The permission policy of an automatic run (E1.111, REQ-hooks-035), run by scripts/hooks/pre-tool-use-auto.test.js and internal/hooks/pretooluse_auto_test.go. keys pins the key of an approval (callKey) for both: each differs from the others but the one it is sameAs. Each case runs the PreToolUse hook (in Node, through the launcher hooks.json installs) in an empty directory, or with git: dirty in a repository on a branch other than the default one with an untracked file, with OSPEC_AUTO_SESSION set to its run directory, OSPEC_AUTO_ALLOW set to the key of each call of allow, the advisory guards off unless env turns one on, files of the given sizes, and with requestsFile the request file left as a symlink or a hard link to a file outside, or as a FIFO (POSIX only). request is the line the hook appends to permission-requests.jsonl, or null when it writes none.
